notes: Frame-review set. Sampling is fixed per clip so the SAM2 tail seed fixture lands on an exact sampled frame; changing fps or duration invalidates the seed index. Clips marked held_out were added after every threshold was fixed and must not be used to tune anything.

clips.subject: Single tuxedo cat, portrait phone video.

clips.notes: Original-motion portion only; the 1/4-speed replay after 8 s is excluded.
clips.subject: Two cats: a grey tabby and a black-and-white tuxedo (the one that jumps). The tail seed is on the grey tabby, so tail_curve is judged against the tabby's tail; a curve on the tuxedo cat is wrong with condition multi_cat. Body skeletons are judged on whichever cat they are drawn on.
One black cat walking, 1080p. Held-out: no threshold in the repository was chosen on it.
One young cat licking its tail, 640x480; the tail is held against the face and body for much of the clip. Held-out: no threshold in the repository was chosen on it.
Dense (8 fps) resampling of Cat Plays used only to harvest pseudo-labels for the tail probe. Not a review clip.
Dense (8 fps) resampling of the jumping clip used only to harvest pseudo-labels for the tail probe. Not a review clip.
